abstract: We establish support-restricted asymptotic density upper bounds strictly below 9/5 = 1.8 across all center phases (x_0, y_0) in F_p^2 for 34 of the 57 collision isomorphism classes of four-level axis-aligned modular hyperbola unions H_p(C; x_0, y_0) = {(x, y) in [0, p-1]^2 : (x - x_0)(y - y_0) = c (mod p) for some c in C} (|C| = 4, C subset F_p^*; Open Cell 10 of no_three_in_line_35 v8), resolving all 29 collision classes with |C cap (C - C)| <= 2 (5 with |C cap D| = 0, 10 with |C cap D| = 1, and 14 with |C cap D| = 2, where D = (C - C) \ {0}) together with 5 classes with |C cap (C - C)| = 3. Building on the two-stage diagonal deletion architecture, 57-class classification, and all-pattern retained half-capacity proposition of no_three_in_line_1 v5, we pair the long physical minus segments x + y = lambda and x + y = 2 - lambda via a change of variables on s_0 in [0, 1), prove two-branch plus-diagonal window duality, and combine shared-flag conditioning with signed-midpoint 1D difference-phase binning for non-root shared coordinates so that active color occupancies remain conditionally independent and dominate their bathtub comparison laws in the increasing-convex order. Exact degree-16 Newton-Cotes rational quadrature (fractions.Fraction), with complete lambda-crossing breakpoints and exact degree-4 Bernstein non-negativity certification on every subinterval, certifies all 34 classes strictly below 9/5 across (t_+, t_-) in [0, 1/2]^2; global all-phase completion for the remaining 23 classes (13 with |C cap D| = 3 and 10 with |C cap D| = 4) remains open.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: Fixed all four issues identified in the review of kjPhmuLyBMAuUbKu: (1) Added the missing branch-+1 lambda crossings t_hi and 1/4 + t_hi (where 1 - lambda and 3/2 - lambda cross 1 + lambda - 2*t_hi) to lam_crits in both evaluators, added explicit subinterval endpoint no-crossing and zone-containment checks, added exact degree-4 Bernstein coefficient non-negativity certification (check_deg4_bernstein_nonneg) proving (p_0, a, b) >= 0 across the entire continuous interval [a_s, b_s] for every color law, and regenerated all 34 class certificates and Table 1; (2) Repaired the folded phase definition in Theorem 3 using the signed representative delta_+ in [-1/2, 1/2] of A + B (mod 1) so w_u(X_u) = 2*dist(X_u + delta_+/2, s/2) determines {U_s(X_u), U_s(X_u + A + B)} identically across all centers (A, B) in [0, 1)^2, and added direct rational verification including the reviewer's point A = B = 3/8, s = 3/4, X_u = 1/20; (3) Supplied the explicit change of variables on s_0 in [0, 1) regrouping the long physical minus segments x + y = lambda and x + y = 2 - lambda in Section 2; (4) Corrected Proposition 1 and verify_section1_taxonomy_and_sos to state and verify that (-4, -3, -2, -1) is the unique class with |R_{>= 3}(C)| = 1 while (-3, -2, -1, 1) has m_C = (1, 2, 2, 2), |R_{>= 2}| = 3, |R_{>= 3}| = 0, and T(C) = 7, and corrected the titles of references [4]-[6] and added [8]-[10].
title: Concentric-Threshold Equivalence, Two-Branch Plus-Diagonal Window Duality, and All-Phase Sub-9/5 Asymptotic Bounds for All 29 Four-Hyperbola Classes with |C cap (C - C)| <= 2 and 5 Classes with |C cap (C - C)| = 3
